title: Introduction to the Seerah and the Roots of Meccan Society
overview: This lecture introduces the spiritual benefits of studying the life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, emphasizing its role in increasing faith and understanding the Quran. It traces the history of Makkah from its establishment by Prophet Ibrahim and Hajar to its eventual decline into idolatry during the Jahiliyyah period.
chapters: The Importance and Benefits of Studying the Seerah
Seerah as a Key to Understanding the Quran
The Origins of Makkah and the Miracle of Zamzam
The Settlement of Jurhum and the Rebuilding of the Ka'bah
The Call to Hajj and the Spread of Monotheism
The Corruption of Tawhid and the Rise of Shirk

title: The Entry of Judaism and Christianity into Arabia and the First Kiswah
overview: This episode explores the historical arrival of Judaism and Christianity in the Arabian Peninsula, focusing on the Jewish settlements in Yathrib and the conversion of the Yemeni King Tibban As'ad. It details the king's siege of Yathrib, his eventual embrace of Judaism through the scholars of the city, and his significant act of being the first to cover the Ka'bah with the Kiswah.
chapters: The Kings of Yemen and the Prophecy of Ethiopia
Tibban As'ad and the Siege of Yathrib
Conversion through the Prophecy of the Tawrah
The Plot of Hudhayl and Honoring the Ka'bah
The History of the Kiswah and the Return to Yemen
